section3_flags.title: Mere admixture
section3_flags.law_summary: A substance obtained by a mere admixture resulting only in the aggregation of the properties of its components, or a process for producing such a substance.
section3_flags.reason: The invention is an admixture of known natural substances whose combined effect is merely the aggregation of the individual properties of neem, turmeric and honey.
section3_flags.how_to_address: Demonstrate a synergistic or unexpected therapeutic effect that is not predictable from the separate components, or include a novel processing step that creates a new chemical entity.

section3_flags.title: Traditional knowledge
section3_flags.law_summary: An invention which, in effect, is traditional knowledge, or an aggregation or duplication of known properties of traditionally known components.
section3_flags.reason: Neem, turmeric and honey are traditional medicinal ingredients, and their combined use in a paste may be considered traditional knowledge.
section3_flags.how_to_address: Provide experimental data showing a non‑obvious improvement over traditional formulations, such as enhanced stability, faster healing, or a unique delivery mechanism.
